correctness.rationale: Monotone OR sweep commutes with unions, reducing worst nonzero binary state to singleton. First-infection along either simple arc costs first sweep plus the number of rank descents after the first edge. Each target is reached by its shorter arc in at most floor(n/2) sweeps. On even n=2m only antipodal target can force m; this requires two length-m descending chains, with n binom(n−2,m−1) orders per source and unique source when m>=3 (opposite rankings contradict overlap). Thus n² binom(n−2,m−1) orders. For n=4 all 24 orders extremal. Independently enumerated 24, 720 and 40,320 permutations at n=4,6,8, confirming 24,216,1280 extremals and universal latency bound. Finite tests only corroborate all-n proof.
